text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it isfor brethren to dwell together in unity!
It islike the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, evenAaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
As the dew of Hermon, and as the dewthat descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORDcommanded the blessing, evenlife for evermore.
